name: librerun-vercel-ai-answer-example
description: Run Contract v1 in TypeScript: the Vercel AI SDK on the LibreRun gateway (blueprint S5/S5-R)
comment: Exact pins, not ranges: this image is rebuilt by CI on every change and an example whose dependencies move underneath it is an example that fails for reasons the reader did not write. There is no package-lock.json because the whole dependency set is these few lines (no zod: the tool's schema is declared as plain JSON Schema, because a zod conversion emits a `$schema` URL the gateway's outbound walk refuses — see server.ts); bump them deliberately, with the container battery green on the new versions. The devDependencies are the type checker only — the image installs with --omit=dev and tsx strips types without checking them, so `npm run typecheck` is what actually reads them (and CI runs it).
